SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, CASE WHEN s.store_id>=900 THEN s.store_id ELSE 0 END AS sg, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dl, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(d.calendar_date) mn, max(d.calendar_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=2) OR (d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5,6

WITH x AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, min(etl_loaded_at) a, max(etl_loaded_at) b FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT count(*), sum(c), min(a), max(b) FROM x
SELECT strftime(etl_loaded_at,'%Y-%m-%d') ld, count(*), min(sale_date), max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) gross_s, sum(r.returns_net) ret, sum(r.net_sales) ns, min(r.business_date), max(r.business_date), count(DISTINCT r.store_id) stores

calls.statement:
WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, sum(l.amount) AS net_sales
  FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT t.fiscal_year, t.fiscal_period, t.fiscal_week,
       round(t.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales,
       round(p.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       round((t.net_sales / p.net_sales - 1) * 100, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly t JOIN weekly p ON p.fiscal_week = t.fiscal_week AND p.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE t.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY t.fiscal_week
